slug: 2025-06-17 Tanzania launching infant biometric registration pilot with UNICEF support

systems.country_label: NIDA infant biometric registration for under-fives, child's identity linked to the mother's National ID; pilot from July 2025 in selected regions with UNICEF
systems.owner: National Identification Authority (NIDA), with UNICEF support

systems.country_label: Universal ID / Jamii Number digital ID project; over 25 million registered, about 81 per cent of adults; integrated with over 124 institutions

note: Identity enrolment only; it says a child will receive a birth certificate and a national ID number at birth but describes no civil registration system or office.
